Students must complete a minimum of 120 units with a Pacific cumulative and program grade point average of 2.0 in order to earn the Bachelor of Music degree with a major in music therapy.

","groupId":"3e465400-76e7-47f5-8dde-01958b489929","position":1,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"General Education Requirements","groupId":"6cc96316-72a4-45e3-9891-01958b490f30","position":2,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

For more details, see General Education

Minimum 28 units and 9 courses that include the following requirements.

","groupId":"1b223097-f6bf-45e1-803c-01958b490f30","position":3,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"CORE Requirements","groupId":"16a83792-cda1-48d0-b780-01958b4c6920","position":4,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) CORE Seminars cannot be taken for Pass/No Credit. 

2) Transfer students with 28 or more transfer credits taken after high school are exempt from both CORE seminars.  

","groupId":"64a31550-b92d-48f4-9ee3-01958b4c6920","position":5,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Breadth Requirement (7 courses, at least 3 units each)","groupId":"0cdad7cb-56b7-4971-b84a-01958b4c6920","position":6,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Note: No more than 2 courses from a single discipline can be used to meet the Breadth Requirement.

","groupId":"0bf265e0-5924-4042-91d6-01958b4c6920","position":7,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Diversity and Inclusion Requirement","groupId":"b4beec48-8f08-48bb-a8a7-01958b4cc564","position":8,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

All students must complete Diversity and Inclusion coursework (at least 3 units)

Note: Diversity and Inclusion courses can also be used to meet the breadth category requirements, or major or minor requirements

","groupId":"ca9352d1-a831-4c60-a917-01958b4cc564","position":9,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":" Fundamental Skills","groupId":"22ddf573-efbd-4d82-8bf6-01958b4d3023","position":10,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students must demonstrate competence in:

Writing

Quantitative Analysis (Math)

Note:  Failure to satisfy the fundamental skills requirements by the end of four semesters of full-time study at the University is grounds for academic disqualification.

","groupId":"0ffc6809-1932-4c11-99b2-01958b4d3023","position":11,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Major Requirements","groupId":"a1c40828-e160-4fdd-8b2c-01958b510854","position":12,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) Students must obtain a grade of B- or better in all Music Therapy courses.

2) Students must receive a grade of B- in MTHR 011 or MTHR 018 before they enroll in upper-division courses.

3) MTHR 150 and MTHR 187 must be repeated for four semesters.

4) Students should select

a) Two units from Class Piano (Section 3C) according to placement exam.

b) Behavioral Health Science Elective (BIO, SPED, SLPA, EDUC & PSYC)
